_note: Playstyle for the Storm Sensei list. An Art beatdown that refills instead of hoarding: Orange Strength, Pikkon's-style blocks, Gathering and Centering put the duelist back to full, so Energy is fuel to spend, not a store. The Relic adds a wound to every attack and takes one off every attack against it, which makes trading hits good and declaring readily right. A first pass: tune it with tools/spsa_tune.py --deck.
